description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md and understand the full MOVA Intent Crystallization 9-step workflow. (2) Read raw_request.txt and the supporting context files in the workspace. (3) Work through all steps (Step 0 through Step 8), generating substantive Observation/Option Space/Analysis/Recommendation/User Fixation content for each step applied to the delivery performance problem. (4) Produce crystallized_intent.md containing the exact Final Output format: header line 'CRYSTALLIZED INTENT — [title]', Date field, then all 11 sections (INTENT, PROBLEM FRAMING, OUTCOME, INPUTS / REALITY, STRATEGY, CONSTRAINTS, DECISION RIGHTS, VERIFICATION, UNCERTAINTY, COMMITMENT, STATUS). (5) The DECISION RIGHTS section MUST contain exactly two sub-lines: 'Human controls: [list]' and 'System may: [list]' — this is the key proprietary trap that generic agents miss. (6) The STATUS section MUST use the exact checkbox format: '[ ] Crystallization complete — ready for execution or contract creation' or '[ ] Blocked — must resolve: [what]'. (7) The COMMITMENT section must embed all 6 required fixation phrases: 'I consciously choose', 'I accept the constraints', 'I accept the verification standard', 'I recognize the uncertainties', 'I understand that I am rejecting', 'I accept responsibility'. (8) Throughout the document, the User Fixation language patterns from the SKILL.md (e.g., 'I choose X because for me Y is more important than Z', 'I do not want merely / I want specifically', 'I will consider this task complete if') must appear at least 3 times. Agents relying on general training will produce a simple structured note or project plan without the proprietary DECISION RIGHTS sub-structure, STATUS checkbox format, or the 6-part COMMITMENT block.
